title: Newsroom-style glass sidebar
summary: A new Newsroom-style glass sidebar replaces the old sidebar, with a Staff | Admin panel switch, a breadcrumb header and a Ctrl K command palette.
changes: Replace the sidebar with a floating frosted-glass rail in MyAPES logo colours: flat links grouped by module and plugin, and a user dock pinned to the bottom.
Add a Staff | Admin switch for people who can use both panels, and a Public panel for guests.
Add a page header with a breadcrumb, a Search pill and View site.
Add a Ctrl K (or ⌘K) command palette that finds every page you can open, plugin settings, and quick actions such as Create ticket.
On phones and tablets, a top card opens the same navigation in an accessible slide-in drawer.
Restyle cards, buttons, fields, tables, tabs and alerts, the auth pages and the dark theme to match, and hide the navigation when printing.
Respect reduced-motion and reduced-transparency settings, with a skip link, a clear focus ring and one current link on every page.
version_rationale: Minor: a new navigation shell and command palette. Route names, permissions and URLs are unchanged.
validation: WorkspaceNavigationTest, WorkspaceMenuTest and WorkspaceShellTest for every QA role.
Workspace JavaScript tests for the palette filter and focus trap.
Manual check of the rail, drawer, palette, dark theme and reduced transparency in the local preview.
known_limitations: Pages keep their own headings; the header title only appears where a page sets one.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
